lina (PM): Putting up a deferral matrix for the Chat/Embeddings/Rerank initiative. Need to decide must-have vs deferred by EOD.

lina (PM): Customer asks: ACME wants embeddings parity + first-class rerank. Also asked for sub-100ms median chat for short prompts.

oscar (Eng): Quick notes: rerank endpoint is straightforward w/ /v1/rerank. Main risk is memory pressure when scoring many candidates synchronously.

mei (ML): Parity: return vector dim and model_version in response. Also include deterministic seed for dedupe.

harper (SRE): Suggest SLOs: chat p95 <120ms, embeddings p99 <300ms, rerank p95 <200ms. Need to plan for Dedicated sizing.

dev-rel (Solutions): Add a low-cost quantized embed model under same endpoint for cost-sensitive customers. Also need exportable CSV for offline evals.

lina (PM): Proposed Phase 1 (must): API contract + SDK examples, sync rerank, basic telemetry, canary plan. Phase 2 (deferred): async rerank, request-level batching, adaptive thresholds.

oscar (Eng): ETA rough: contract + tests (2d), /v1/rerank implement (3w), embeddings parity (1.5w), SDKs (1w each).

harper (SRE): Rollout: internal 5% canary -> ACME pilot opt-in -> GA. Rollback if error rate +1% or p99 regresses by >200ms.

mei (ML): Quality gate: top-1 precision on ACME eval set, block GA if MRR drops >3%.

dev-rel (Solutions): I'll prepare customer pilot docs + data retention notes.

ci-bot: Created branch "feat/rerank-embed-deferral-matrix" and opened PR for review.

lina (PM): Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept timelines and gates. I'll lock Phase 1 scope tomorrow morning.

oscar (Eng): :thumbsup:

mei (ML): :thumbsup:

harper (SRE): :thumbsup:

dev-rel (Solutions): :thumbsup:
